Good Food, Friendly Service & Pleasant Atmosphere
Aug 2026 • Friends
We had a lovely dining experience at 5 Spice Restaurant in Hanoi. We tried the stir-fried seafood noodles, vegetable spring rolls, rice noodle soup with beef, and beef tenderloin with black pepper sauce. Everything was tasty, and the service was good. The atmosphere was also pleasant and comfortable.

For my personal taste, I found the food could have been a little spicier. We asked if they had chilli paste, but unfortunately they didn’t. However, they kindly provided fresh chilli pieces, which was a nice touch.

Overall, good food, friendly service, and a pleasant atmosphere. A good place to enjoy a meal while in Hanoi.

Okay if you're really stuck.
May 2026 • Couples
We went here on a recommendation from our Hotel and we weren't impressed.

The location and decor are very good and the service is okay but not brilliant, For us we were expecting really nice Vietnamese food however the food we had was disappointing and a bit bland. Considering this isn't a cheap place to eat we have had much better food at lots of other places which were a lot cheaper.

Would go back if there were no other options however we wouldn't be in a hurry to return.

Lovely place to eat in Hanoi Old Quarter
Oct 2025 • Couples
This lovely restaurant located in the old quarter of Hanoi had beautiful food and a great menu to chose from. The service was great and payment afterwards was easy. The restaurant was clean and had clean toilets as well. It was well priced. We had the set menu which consisted of 3 entrees, 3 mains with rice and dessert. The food was delicious. Would recommend eating here. The restaurant had two levels so plenty of seating available.
